headline: WE GO-6 unveils 'First and Last' MV from 1st EP
sub: Angel Unit leads the alt-rock pop double title track
source: Source: Korean media (Topstar News, AP Shinmun)
caption:
Multi-persona boy group WE GO-6 has dropped its first EP 'SIX HEARTS', fronted by the music video for 'First and Last'.

'First and Last' is a guitar- and drum-driven alt-rock pop song about confessing your feelings while fearing it could end before it even begins. The MV follows the group's Angel Unit. The five-track EP also includes prologue single 'Monster' and 'Luminaria', which the group first performed at a Hangang Park busking event earlier this month.
